content.what_it_is: MATLAB script plotting eta and sediment concentration snapshots for the FUNWAVE-TVD single_vessel_morphology case; byte-identical (same source SHA-256) to multi_vessel_morphology/plot_wave.m, and here the fdir target single_vessel_fr_13 (L2) matches the containing case directory. Loads dep_00000 (L5), mirrors the half-domain N=2*n-1 (L8), dx=dy=1.0 (L11-L12). For snapshots nfile=[40 80 120] (L18) labeled min={'80' '160' '240'} sec (L20), loads eta_, mask_, C_ (L36-L38), masks with mask<1 (L40-L41), mirrors ETA/CH (L44-L47), and fills a 6x1 tight_subplot stack (L30) in pairs with ax=[0 4500 0 120] (L31): odd panels ETA pcolor caxis [-0.3 1.0] with time titles (L53-L62), even panels log10(CH*2680*1000.0) concentration in mg/L caxis [0 2.999] (L67-L74); xlabel on the final panel only (L77-L79). Print commented out (L89).
entities: min time-label cell array L20 (shadows builtin min)
calls: tight_subplot L30 (external helper, not shipped in this directory)
unresolved: byte-identical duplicate of multi_vessel_morphology/plot_wave.m; in this directory the fdir target matches the case name, suggesting this is the original and the multi_vessel copy is the stale one — not decidable from file contents alone

tight_subplot is required but, unlike the cohesive case directory, no copy is co-located here as far as this file shows; 2680*1000 mg/L conversion provenance unstated; variable min shadows the builtin
